Trove report: this month (since Oct 1)

Headline
  Spend        ~$73.50 (estimated at list prices, not an invoice); 1.6M tokens
               (measured)
  Waste found  at least ~$5.85, 8% of spend (estimated; overlapping findings
               counted once)
  Savings      ~$0.50 so far (estimated)
  Measured     not enough data yet to compare sessions with and without an
               optimizer. The dollar savings above are estimates.

Spend by agent and model
  Agent        Requests  Tokens (measured)  Cost (estimated)
  claude_code        20                 1M           ~$50.00
  codex_cli          10               520K           ~$23.50

  Model     Requests  Tokens (measured)  Cost (estimated)
  claude-a        10               520K           ~$25.00
  claude-b        10               520K           ~$25.00
  gpt-x           10               520K           ~$23.50

Biggest leaks (estimated, overlapping, not additive)
  1. Repeated tool results: ~$4.50 (estimated), 60K tokens (estimated)
     Do this: duplicate_result_collapser = "on"
     Add this line under [optimizers] in config.toml. It applies from your next
     session.
  2. Noisy tool output: ~$3.00 (estimated), 90K tokens (estimated)
     Do this: trove optimize status
     noise_normalizer can remove this. It is not offered yet: Trove needs more
     sessions to be sure it is worth it.
  3. Prompt cache misses: ~$1.35 (estimated), 27K tokens (estimated)
     Cache misses happen when the start of a request changes between turns.
     Avoid editing early context mid-session.

Optimizers
  volatile_prefix_mover: off
  noise_normalizer: off
    Saved ~$0.50 (estimated).
  output_trimmer: off
  duplicate_result_collapser: off
    Would have saved ~$3.60 (estimated, shadow mode).
    To turn on, add under [optimizers] in config.toml:
    duplicate_result_collapser = "on"
  cache_breakpoints: off
  Guardrail events: none.
  No regression detected locally. Trove checks retries, tool errors and
  re-fetches; it does not prove output quality.

Third-party tools (each tool's own claim next to what Trove measured)
  rtk v1.1.0: on (license Apache-2.0, permissive)
    Claimed by the tool: "reduces LLM token consumption by 60-90% on common dev
    commands" (https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk; not checked by Trove)
    Measured, prompt tokens per request: 40K on vs 50K off (25 sessions on, 25
    off). Sessions with the optimizer on sent fewer prompt tokens per request
    than sessions with it off; sessions differ, so this supports but does not
    prove the saving.
    Measured, cost per session: $0.82 on vs $1.02 off (25 sessions on, 25 off).
    Sessions with the tool on cost less than sessions with it off, beyond what
    chance explains; sessions differ, so this supports but does not prove the
    saving.
    Overhead: 0 tokens on every request while on (estimated; declared). It is
    part of every prompt, so the measured figures above already include it.
    Sessions with the tool on are compared with later sessions without it.
    Sessions differ in size and task, so this supports a conclusion but does not
    prove it.

Recommendations (suggestions only; Trove changes nothing on its own)
  None yet. These need more recorded usage.
